questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs display traffic laws you must obey. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians entering or in a crosswalk. Watch carefully when driving through intersections or turning, especially where children may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that from this lane, you can either turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a Y intersection is ahead where the road splits. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully in areas where pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are in or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully and slowly through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your current lane leads off the freeway. You can either change lanes to continue on the freeway or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road turns sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that another road will join your road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed and increase your following distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street, slow down, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low bridge or overpass ahead. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Look for traffic and yield the right-of-way before proceeding when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green downward arrow over a lane means traffic in that lane is allowed to proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming. Be alert for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through the middle means the action is not allowed. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it to their side, riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings tell drivers about road hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic is coming from both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest legal speed for that road. You should drive slower than the limit when weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger, the group should form a single line.
